payload.rationale: No current research was supplied, so this rests on background knowledge. 'Why Did I Get Married Again?' is a Tyler Perry film slated for Netflix; Perry's recent Netflix originals (Mea Culpa, Divorce in the Black, Duplicity, Straw, Ruth & Boaz) have very consistently debuted at #1 on the US movie chart, often even with only a partial week of availability. The existence of this contract for the week ending Sep 20, 2026 suggests the film is released or imminent around this window, which would make it a leading candidate for the top US spot. Key uncertainties: I cannot confirm the exact release date (if it drops after Sep 20 or was released much earlier, the answer is likely No), nor the competing slate that week (a major Netflix original film or a strong licensed title could take #1; a second-week Perry title can also be overtaken by a fresh release). Reason the estimate may be too high: the release date may not fall inside or right before the measured week, or a bigger tentpole film may release the same Friday, and 'Top 10 US' is the country-specific chart, which can diverge from the global chart. Reason it may be too low: Perry's track record on Netflix US is near-perfect for #1 debuts, and if the film premiered Friday Sep 18 or the prior week, historical patterns would imply well above even odds. Net: roughly a coin flip, weighted by strong franchise/creator base rate against release-timing uncertainty.
